mechanisms.name: deformation-induced alpha2 to gamma phase transformation

evidence.quote: the deformation-induced phase transformation of α2 into γ occurs in the α2-Ti3Al layer.
The dislocation slip, twinning and the solid-state phase transformation are the main deformation mechanisms at high temperature.

The change of the nano-hardness of the γ-TiAl phase is mainly attributed to the strain hardening which is caused by the dislocation pile-ups in the γ-TiAl
Dislocation pile-ups will generate the back stress with a long-range stress field and prevent further dislocation emission from the dislocation source
